name: Plum Tea
source:
You play as a senior high-school girl who moves into a new school to complete her final semester. She's not a futa herself and has never met one, so curiosity and romance quickly ensues when encounters one of the few futa girls in her class. Will she take the romance slow or just get straight to juicy bits.

[From [url=http://www.saintxtail.com/#!new-page/c1jn]Official webpage[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名高中女生，进入新学校完成最后一个学期的学业。她本人不是futa人，也从未见过futa人，所以当她遇到班上为数不多的futa女孩之一时，好奇心和浪漫很快就随之而来。她会慢慢地浪漫还是直接进入有趣的阶段。

[来自[url=http://www.saintxtail.com/#!new-page/c1jn]官方网页[/url]]
